§6Elemental Materials§f

§aHunt elementals, harvest their rods, and brew elemental dusts!§f

Three mobs spawn at §elight ≤8§f: §bBlizz§f (cold biomes, drops Blizz Rods), §bBlitz§f (dry biomes, Blitz Rods), and §bBasalz§f (mountains, Basalz Rods). Craft rods shapeless for §e2x§f powder, or pulverize for §e4x§f.

Combine powder with Redstone and a catalyst to make elemental dusts, §e2 per craft§f. §bPyrotheum§f (Blaze Powder + Sulfur) smelts ore to ingot in the grid. §bCryotheum§f (Snowball) freezes things. §bAerotheum§f (Niter) is the wind element. §bPetrotheum§f (Bitumen) breaks ore to §e2x§f dust in the grid.

§ePS:§f All four melt to their respective fluids in a Magma Crucible, §e250 mB§f each.
